suites.cross_environment_agreement: All 151 checks are identical between the producer worktree and the clean clone once measured timings are normalised. The only differing fields are elapsed seconds and the run label.

suites.name: immutable_readback_verification
suites.command: git clone --no-hardlinks then git show <result_commit>:<path> for every manifest artifact
suites.note: Every artifact in the manifest was read back by immutable commit from a separate clone and compared on both SHA-256 and byte count.

fault_injection_matrix.note: No network dependency exists in this unit, so no network-interruption fault can be injected against it. The transport-level analogue exercised instead is at-least-once redelivery in fx-06 and the truncated append in fx-07.

first_pass_detail: The first executed build of the scanner failed against the live ledger, and the adversarial suite failed on its first run. Eight scanner defects were found and repaired, plus one incorrect test assertion.

defects_found_and_repaired.defect: Attempt-key aliasing split 55 attempts, producing 55 spurious ILLEGAL_TRANSITION_REFUSED defects and leaving 55 of 508 events unapplied.
Legitimate at-least-once redelivery raised a spurious FILE_ORDER_NOT_SEQ_ORDER defect and turned integrity DEFECTIVE.
A refused false-completion attempt was invisible in the report summary, so the guard firing could not be audited.
A FENCED attempt with no successor was reported as NONE_SUCCESSOR_CARRIES_WORK, silently retiring live work with no recovery action.
PRODUCER_SELF_ACCEPTANCE was unreachable because the generic actor-prefix check ran first, so the specific fault was misdiagnosed.
The scan raised ValueError and crashed when every event naming a task was refused.
parse_instant accepted invalid calendar dates such as month 13, fabricating an epoch value from a malformed lease expiry.
A false-completion assertion at a structurally legal lifecycle position would have been admitted, because the guard was subordinate to the transition table.
Test defect, not a scanner defect: the key-order determinism test compared whole-report digests, which legitimately include the ledger's own digest, so it asserted something false.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Test corrected to compare the reconstruction and to assert that only the ledger digest differs.

defects_found_and_repaired.found_by: return-phase review of the verifier's own output
defects_found_and_repaired.defect: Tooling secret-hygiene defect, not a scanner defect: verify_readback.py recorded its --remote argument verbatim, and this repository's origin URL embeds an access token, so the read-back report would have committed a credential into permanent evidence.
